Rooms.Name: #bThe Artemisian's Sanctuary#N
Rooms.Description:
Before you lies the golden temple of the Artemisian Order.  Behind 
the door you hear the faint whispers of the sisterhood within.  Above
the door you see the words "Boethia Uber Allelon," the Artemisian 
Credo. Although these lovely women are more than happy to help those 
in need, they are not too fond of unwanted guests!

Rooms.Name: #bThe Great Hall of Artemis#N
Rooms.Description:
As you enter this holy temple, you become aware that you are being 
watched...but by whom?  You hear the echoes of footsteps, but see no 
one as you turn to look.  This room smells of the wild flowers that 
are growing from the floor.  Somehow, sunlight filters through the 
arched ceiling, making you feel as if you are still in the forest 
outside.

Rooms.Name: #bThe Altar Room#N
Rooms.Description:
A large statue of the goddess Artemis greets you as you enter the
room.  She stands before a bloodstained altar upon which the unjust 
are slain in her honor.  Several smaller statues of the Goddesses 
stand guard at her side.  As you move about this room, you can feel 
the watchful eyes of the sisterhood upon you.  Perhaps you will 
become the next to lose your life upon their altar?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The altar is stained with the blood of the men and the beasts 
sacrificed to Artemis.  You notice that the stones at the base do not 
quite fit into the floor...perhaps something is beneath it?

Dark brown hair with just a tint of auburn flows life-like behind the
statue of Melody.  She stands poised, her lithe body ready to pounce
into action in an instant.  As you move around the room you notice 
her hypnotic gaze following you around the room... like a huntress
watching her prey.  Armed only with her claws, you know this
Artemisian goddess would make a formidable adversary as well as a
faithful ally.

Kaleen grins back at you as you gaze upon her statue.  The petite 
ratwoman is the adopted daughter of Lovely and Drogg, and can call 
many of the Artemisians her sisters and brothers.  Her statue is 
adorned with a wreath of laurel leaves, a bow, and a quiver of 
arrows.  She wears the mark of the Artemisians on her left arm as a 
symbol of her allegiance to her proud heritage.

The maiden Goddess Artemis is strong and tall.  She wears only a 
wreath of flowers and a quiver of arrows.  In one hand she holds a 
golden bow, and in the other, a double-headed axe...dripping with 
blood.

Rooms.Name: #bThe Adelpheans' Room#N
Rooms.Description:
The Artemisian Adelpheans are skilled in the arts of healing and 
magic. They assist the High Priestesses with the preperations of 
rituals and sacrifices.  You see a large pool here, built for the 
ritual bathing of the victims before they are sacrificed.  Most men 
will come here willingly with a beautiful Adelphean, but leave here 
weeping when they realize what is to be done to them.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The shimmering pool is quite inviting, but the only souls allowed 
inside are the Artemisians, and those they are to sacrifice.

Rooms.Name: #bThe Maiden's Sanctuary#N
Rooms.Description:
Before an Artemisian may become an Amazon, she must endure a 
period of intense training as a Maiden.  The Maidens are trained in 
the arts of war, as well as the lore of the forest.  This room is 
where the maidens spend much of their time studying and practicing 
their skills.  The walls are covered with murals of the Artemisian 
hunt, during which Artemis transforms herself into a white doe, which 
the Maidens must capture alive.

Rooms.Name: #bThe Amazon's Training Room#N
Rooms.Description:
This room is where the mighty Amazon warriors of the Artemisian
Order practice their deadly skills.  the Amazons are skilled hunters,
capable of dispatching man or beast with eerie efficiency.  The walls 
are covered with murals of the many battles fought for the Order 
before Artemis.

Rooms.Name: #bThe Amazon's Armory#N
Rooms.Description:
This is where the Amazons keep the spoils of their hard fought 
battles.  The treasure in this room is for all of the Artemisians to 
share.

Rooms.Name: #bHallway of Secrets#N
Rooms.Description:
This hidden hallway is where the private chambers of the Order's  
leaders can be found.  The floor here is covered with a thick blue  
carpet, just right for walking barefoot on.  You can barely hear the
noise from the Altar through the thick wooden door.

Rooms.Name: #bBigBird's Chambers#N
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the private chambers of BigBird.  BigBird has
decided to decorate the room with a dungeon motif.  An Iron Maiden 
lies against one wall, and various instruments of torture are 
scattered around the room.  The blood of her latest victim is 
dripping on the floor.  In one corner is a large bookshelf, piled 
high with stuffed animals!?!?!?  Well, perhaps BigBird has a nice 
side after all ...(?)

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This shelf is full of cute and fuzzy stuffed animals.  Among them, 
you can see a few bunnies, a couple of bears, and Barney, the purple 
dinosaur.

This pain inflicting device is from the late 1800's.  Although aged 
and less used now adays, it still proves as a worthwhile method of  
distributing pain and extracting valuable information.

Rooms.Name: #bBronwyn's Chambers#N
Rooms.Description:
You have entered Bronwyn's Chamber. As you look around, all you
can do is smile. Bronwyn may be a grown woman, but looking around, 
you'd think she was a child. You look to the left of the room and you 
see a pile of stuffed bunnies everywhere! As you continue to look 
around the room, straight ahead you see an antique four-poster bed, 
with a handmade comforter on it, probably fifty or more years old 
itself, along with some other antique furniture around the room.  Off 
to the side of the bed, on the nightstand, is a picture in an elegant 
frame. To the right of the bed is a large bay window with a 
picturesque view of Midgaard. Bronwyn can often be found resting in 
her window seat, thinking about what life has in store for her.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look at the pile of bunnies, you get the urge to go and jump 
into them like a child would, but you suppress it for now.

As you look at this portrait you see Bronwyn and her sexy, loving 
husband Fresh, her sister Madison and Madison's adorable husband 
Smilex. They all look so cute!

Outside the window, you can see people shuffling about the town. Off 
to the east, you can see Harold the Undertaker doing busineses with a 
bloody person whom you cannot make out at this point.

Rooms.Name: #bMystic's #yL#mo#rv#ge #bS#yh#ga#wc#mk#N
Rooms.Description:
As you push aside the beads hanging in the doorway, you feast your
eyes on a vibrantly decorated room.  In the very center of the room, 
is a soft, comfy looking bed that has seen many happy nights.  There 
are pictures completely covering the walls of her VERY extended 
family.  There is a soft breeze coming from the balcony, where Mystic 
can often be seen reading or just thinking.  There are several old 
bean bag chairs scattered about the room.  Scattered around the room 
are lava lamp in every color imaginable.  This room would be peaceful 
and calm.  That is if the party girlie would turn down the music.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
What music is she playing??? #yL#mo#rv#ge #bS#yh#ga#wc#mk#N,
of course!

Rooms.Name: #bHallway of Immortality#N
Rooms.Description:
This hallway is dark, lit only by the cracks of light escaping 
from underneath four doors.  The northern door looks oddly enough 
like a visor, you can't begin to fathom how to operate it... The door 
to the east and west are small and are located several feet off the 
ground.  The door to the south appears to be made of stout oak.

Exits.Description: The light eminating from the crack is #bc#ro#mo#gl#yi#we#cs#N!

Rooms.Name: #bKarli's Choklit Paradise#N
Rooms.Description:
This relatively small room is approximately 20 by 20 feet and made 
of pure solid milk chocolate.  Little Oompa Loompas run about mixing 
chocolate, and creating candies for the kiddie winks.  Chocolate 
kisses line the ceiling, waiting to be eaten.  Many buckets (made of 
chocolate also) are scattered about the room, all marked and 
containing a different kind of scrumdidilyumptious candy.  In a 
special section of the room, several pictures float in mid-air... one 
depicting her beautiful daughter, Medea... one of her whip-mistress 
mommy, Lovely...one of her lovely Goddess and sister, Brigantia... 
and one of the WHOLE Artemisian clan! Whips of all sort lie on the 
ground just beneath the pictures (seemingly used veeeery frequently).  
A great portrait of the Goddess Artemis is carved into the chocolate 
of the back wall.

Welcome to Karli's Choklit Paradise...

Rooms.Name: #bHallway of Secrets#N
Rooms.Description:
This hidden hallway is where the private chambers of the Order's
leaders can be found.  The floor here is covered with a thick blue
carpet, just right for walking barefoot on.  You can barely hear the
noise from the Altar through the thick wooden door.

Exits.Description:
You hear loud music making you want to dance.  A large neon sign 
reads "#bMystic's #yL#mo#rv#ge #bS#yh#ga#wc#mk#N...#gThe #bCooliest 
#mPlace #yin #gElite#w!!!#N"

Rooms.Name: #bJesse's #gHideaway#N
Rooms.Description:
As you enter this abode the first thing you feel is the soft plush
green carpeting beneath your feet and at the same time you hear the 
songs of dolphins (which is coming from the small pool in the floor). 
The room is decorated in soft Earth tones which gives it a sort of 
cozy, homey feeling.  On the far wall of the room there is a large 
overstuffed green couch with pillows thrown about and from which one 
can watch their favorite football game on the large screen TV, 
complete with stero on top of it for easy listening or a kick butt 
party tune.  (It's no secret this girl likes to party!)  On the side 
wall there is a loft bed complete with a dark green comforter and 
pillows galore.  The final thing you notice is the computer desk 
strewn with papers and books the only hint that this girl is not as 
organized as she looks.  One the desk there is also a photo album 
that contains pictures of the good times in her life.  There is also
a small plaque here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see Jesse's only pet, a baby dolphin named 'Sasha'.

You notice it is a 3 disc changer with Jesse's favorite tunes in for 
the playing '101 Great drinking songs', 'Club Mix Galore', and 
'Celine Dion'

Lots and lots of school books there.(not to mention the occasional 
romance novel *wink*)

You see Jesse in pics with her daughter Claudette and other members 
of her family and friends.

"Good friends and Good times always welcome, sit and take a load  
off!"

Rooms.Name: #bHallway of Philos#N
Rooms.Description:
This is the hallway upon which you will find the room of the
leaders of the Gargareans, the Philos. The floor here is covered with 
a thick blue carpet, just right for walking barefoot on.

Rooms.Name: #bSpellbinder's Chamber#N
Rooms.Description: Spellie needs to re-decorate.

Rooms.Name: #bSmilex's Rockin Room#N
Rooms.Description:
As you enter this spacious abode, the smell of burning incense
overcomes you.  The room is very dark, with candles glowing all 
around, and black lights on the ceiling, giving a florescent glow to 
the posters on the wall.  In the center of the room, there are two 
computers set up, one next to the other, obviously where Smilex and 
Madison sit and play with the internet.  There is a speaker in each 
of the four corners, and the music of Boyz II Men is playing softly.  
The entertainment center is placed so that it can be operated and 
viewed from while sitting at the computers.  On one of the screens 
the words "I love Madison" are moving slowly across, and on the other 
it reads "I love Smilex".  There is a futon in front of the 
entertainment center, to sit on while watching TV, and if you listen 
quietly, you can hear the squeaking of a mouse. Perhaps this is 
Roger, Smilex's pet.  The walls seem to glow, making you think you 
are protected.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's white, kind of dirty, but looks very comfortable.  Have a seat,
relax.

Not much to say, they are computers, they look like computers, they 
sound like computers.  The screen savers announce Smilex's and 
Madison's true love for one another.

Roger is a small mouse, about 3 inches long plus a tail.  He is grey 
and fuzzy, and very cute.  He won't hurt you.  You can even pet him 
if you wish.  He answers to Roger and Rog.

Rooms.Name: #bThe Ristorante D'Asilasilab#N
Rooms.Description:
Welcome to the Ristorante D'Asilasilab! Please come in, make 
yourself comfortable, and enjoy dining at EliteMUD's first Italian 
restaurant. Sample our fine food while swooning to the styling sounds 
of Johnny "Pibbman" Powell (tips accepted at the door). Our specials 
today are listed on the sign to your right. Here is your menu.
Enjoy!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
THE RISTORANTE D'ASILASILAB
 
Omlette of Suun Lu...........................45 gold pieces
Ogreburger with pitch black coke.............60 gold pieces
Onion Rings of the Universe..................25 gold pieces
Froboz Frappe...............................100 gold pieces
Caesar salad (fresh from Rome)...............25 gold pieces
Katrina's Humble Pie.........................45 gold pieces
 
All entrees served with hot bread and your choice of
Dragon Hatchling Stew or our famous Moria Veggie Medley

Please seat yourself.
 
Our specials today are:
Spellbinder's Mexican Fido Gumbo....75 gold pieces
Mystic's Black Olive Delight........60 gold pieces
Chicken a la Pibbman................65 gold pieces

As you gaze at this large Italian man you get the feeling that you 
should just ignore whatever is going on behind the door he is 
guarding. If you have "business" to discuss, then this is the place 
to go. Just make sure that you show the proper respect to the Family.

Rooms.Name: #YZagreus' #bHideaway#N
Rooms.Description:
You have entered Zagreus' cluttered study - clearly belonging to a
man of solitary habits.  The candles perched on odd scraps of clear 
space provide only a meager amount of light,  but enough to reveal 
walls lined with floor to  ceiling oak bookcases stuffed with 
manuscripts, scrolls, and bound leather volumes.  A quick scan of 
visible titles reveals subjects ranging from metaphysics, philosophy 
and the occult to histories, folklore, astronomy and scattered 
treatises on sexual practices.  To the right a large desk struggles 
under an deluge of notebooks, spilt containers of ink, puddles of 
candle wax, and small mountains of  books and scrolls.  Behind the 
desk sits a very large comfy chair, worn and ragged but sturdy.  In a 
far, dark corner you catch a glimpse of a large couch covered in 
blankets and pillows causing it to resemble an unmade comfortable 
bed.  A number of simple wooden chairs scattered about the 
room have been put to use holding books and papers,  but are still 
available for guests willing to clear them. Although cluttered and 
dusty, the room tempts you to spend a moment of quiet time, to read 
or engage in casual conversation.

Rooms.Name: #bHallway of Secrets#N
Rooms.Description:
This hidden hallway is where the private chambers of the Order's
leaders can be found.  The floor here is covered with a thick blue
carpet, just right for walking barefoot on.  You can barely hear the
noise from the Altar through the thick wooden door.

Rooms.Name: #bUrd's Lounge#N
Rooms.Description:
You come into a more dimly illuminated room and you find yourself
having to adjust to the dim lighting for a few seconds. On a far side 
of the room you see a the light of a small candle burning over a book 
which glows in it's own distinct way. As you come further into the 
room you catch the aroma of sweet spring flowers drifting in the air 
and you instantly feel relieved. You can now perceive a small desk on 
a wall on which there appears to be little more then some old scrolls 
and a portrait. And on a wall on the opposite side of the room you 
see a comfortable looking sofa with nice big pillows in it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A family picture of Urd, her parents (daddy Xenos and mama Chani), 
and her grandparents (Helm and Brigantia).

You notice it has a magical air about it, it's flame doesn't seem to
be affected by the small turbulence in the air. It reads "I am the 
light that shines in the darkness."

It's not a particularly beautiful sofa but it looks comfortable in a
strange way with all the big many colored pillows in it. A small 
heart shaped pillow sits tucked away among the other pillows.

Rooms.Name: #bRelm's #gTropical #mParadise#N
Rooms.Description:
You are surrounded by luscious ferns and tall vine-covered trees,
deep in a tropical jungle.  The air is hot and humid, making you 
sweat. Large exotic flowers bloom throughout the dense foliage in 
striking colors of bright orange, red, and purple.  You can hear 
various animals and birds calling and whistling, forming strange 
melodies that are making you uneasy.  As you look around, you spot 
mysterious cat-like tracks sunk in the rich damp soil.  A small 
stream runs by your feet, glistening in the scattered sunlight that 
tries to break through the dense canopy. Under the darkest shadows, 
you sense that you can see glowing eyes and the glistening of sharp 
teeth, but they disappear quickly, maybe moving in for a closer look
at you, the stranger.  You get a feeling of awe and respect for 
whatever find its home here, living in such beauty, and uncertain 
danger as well..
§N

Mobs.Name: hunter warrior woman Arts
Mobs.LongDescription: The woman #bhunter#Y stands aloof from the games of knights.
Mobs.Description:
Although invited to participate in the Knight's games - the jousting,
wrestling and other forms of hand to hand combat, the woman scoffed at
them as "boys' games".  She chose instead to continue her work
protecting the children and her own society of women.  She is secure in
her knowledge of her own strength and feels no need to constantly prove
herself.  On her tunic you see the emblem of the clan #bArtemisian#N.

Objects.Name: statue artemisians
Objects.ShortDescription: the statue of an Artemisian Amazon Warrior
Objects.Description: An Amazon warrior weeps over the remains of her clan.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This deserted clanhouse was once the home of the Artemisians
clan. For a time, no man was safe and the sisterhood ruled
as far as the eye can see. But no more -- a great clan is
gone but never forgotten.
